response.title: DBT payment failure handling
response.description: The system shall record the PFMS failure reason for every failed DBT payment, move the application to Payment failed, notify the applicant by SMS to correct bank details within 30 days, re-validate the corrected account through PFMS, and include the application in the next weekly payment batch.
acceptanceCriteria: Given PFMS returns "account not Aadhaar-seeded" for a payment, when the status file is processed, then the application moves to Payment failed with that reason and the applicant receives an SMS within 5 minutes.
Given the applicant updates bank details and PFMS validation succeeds, when the next weekly batch runs, then the application is included and its status is Payment initiated.
Given 30 days pass without correction, when the daily job runs, then the application is listed to the DSWO for follow-up.
response.rationale: Adds the missing exception flow for failed DBT payments defined in ANS-1.
